from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,re,statistics,subprocess,sys
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('stem');a=p.parse_args()
lab=Path('F:/Projects/tyrax2-lab-20261001');log=lab/(a.stem+'.log');snap=lab/(a.stem+'-snapshot.log')
assert not snap.exists();snap.write_bytes(log.read_bytes())
flat=snap.read_text(errors='replace').replace('\r','').replace('\n','')
assert 'LIGHTSPLITPHASE done first=11000' in flat
fixture=json.loads((lab/'light-split/fixture.json').read_text());results=[]
pattern=r'LOG: LIGHTSPLIT phase=(\d+) f=(\d+) n=(\d+) pool=([0-9.]+) render=([0-9.]+) recv=([0-9.]+) beam=([0-9.]+) render=([0-9.]+) poolcalls=(\d+) beamcalls=(\d+) rebuild=(\d+)/(\d+)'
profile=list(re.finditer(pattern,flat))
for phase,name in enumerate(fixture['phases']):
 first=phase*2200+1100
 row=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([sys.executable,'F:/Projects/tyra-editor/tools/tyrax2-timing.py',str(snap),'--first',str(first),'--frames','512','--hz','60'],text=True))
 periods=[]
 for b in flat.split('LOG: FRAMETIME ')[1:]:
  b=b.split('LOG:')[0];f=re.search(r'\bf=(\d+)',b)
  if f and first<=int(f[1])<first+500:
   vals={field:float(re.search(r'\b'+field+r'=([0-9.]+)',b)[1]) for field in ['period','pre','stall']}
   periods.append(dict(frame=int(f[1]),**vals))
 assert [x['frame'] for x in periods]==list(range(first,first+500,50)),periods
 prof=[m for m in profile if int(m[1])==phase and first<=int(m[2])<first+500]
 assert [int(m[2]) for m in prof]==list(range(first,first+500,50)),[(m[1],m[2]) for m in prof]
 names=['pool_total_ms','pool_submit_ms','pool_collect_ms','beam_total_ms','beam_submit_ms','pool_submits_per_frame','beam_submits_per_frame','pool_batch_rebuilds_per_frame','beam_batch_rebuilds_per_frame']
 means={n:statistics.mean(float(m[i+4])/(int(m[3]) if i>=5 else 1) for m in prof) for i,n in enumerate(names)}
 means['pool_other_ms']=means['pool_total_ms']-means['pool_submit_ms']
 means['beam_other_ms']=means['beam_total_ms']-means['beam_submit_ms']
 row.update(phase=phase,name=name,period_windows=periods,mean_period_ms=statistics.mean(x['period'] for x in periods),mean_pre_ms=statistics.mean(x['pre'] for x in periods),profile_means=means)
 row['delivered_rate_from_period_hz']=1000/row['mean_period_ms'];results.append(row)
out=dict(fixture=fixture,log=str(snap),log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(snap.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),elf_sha256=hashlib.sha256((lab/(a.stem+'.elf')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),results=results)
(lab/(a.stem+'-summary.json')).write_bytes((json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
for r in results: print(r['phase'],r['name'],round(r['mean_ms'],3),'ms',round(r['delivered_rate_from_period_hz'],2),'Hz',r['profile_means'])
